text:
erin: Observed truncated token outputs in eu-west1 since 09:12 UTC, ~5% of requests. Repro on dedicated pool only. Proposing urgent pin of image to redwood/model-server:v1.4.2-20260320 and fast-roll to Dedicated EU pool. Requesting expedited approvals to skip long canary due to live impact.
alice: What's rollback plan + verification steps? :eyes:
erin: Rollback = revert image to v1.4.1 and flip tokenizer fast-path feature flag off. Verification: smoke curl + token_truncate.count metric, p95/p99 latency. Window: surge window 20:00-21:00 UTC.
ben: pinging infra and oncall. @sre-oncall, can you accept skip-canary if we have auto-rollback conditions?
sre-oncall: I see the spike. If automation will rollback on token_truncate.count > baseline*5 for 10m or p99 > 2s for 5m, i can approve skip-canary. add manual kubectl steps to runbook too.
carol: Product ok with expedited path but require queued customer note to support; pm @lena to draft and hold for success.
lena: Draft ready, will post after deploy success. Also need SLA impact statement.
erin: deploy-bot: request expedited-deploy env=eu-west1 image=redwood/model-server:v1.4.2-20260320 canary=false rollback=v1.4.1 window=2026-03-20T20:00Z-21:00Z

deploy-bot: [deploy request created] id=DR-8929 metadata: author=erin env=eu-west1 image=redwood/model-server:v1.4.2-20260320 canary=false rollback=v1.4.1 approvers_needed=3
frank: quick q — any model or schema changes? or purely runtime tokenizer fix?
erin: purely runtime codepath, no model weight/schema changes.
alice: approving — verified rollback steps & smoke tests. :thumbsup:
ben: approving; standing by for rollback.
sre-oncall: approving; set alert thresholds and will monitor token_truncate.count and p99. Implemented kubectl rollback command in runbook.
erin: doing preflight checks:
```
# preflight
curl -sS https://eu-west1.health/probe | grep OK
jq .status /tmp/serving-health.json
```
all good.
deploy-bot: [DR-8929] starting rollout to eu-dedicated-1 pool parallelism=4
deploy-bot: [DR-8929] stage=deploying pod=eu-dedicated-1-11 image=redwood/model-server:v1.4.2-20260320
frank: tails show slight p99 blip during pod starts but within threshold.
sre-oncall: token_truncate.count downtrend observed after new pods stabilised. continuing watch.
alice: manual smoke ok from my tests.
deploy-bot: [DR-8929] stage=complete rollout_status=success duration=4m12s
erin: rolling remaining hosts. Support hold until I confirm full pool healthy.
carol: tag changelog id CL-5619 pls.
dave: adding clear rollback automation criteria to ticket and enabling auto-rollback on threshold breach.
erin: initiating post-deploy verification runbook (replay, sample traces, metrics snapshot).
frank: replay load test passes; throughput unchanged.
sre-oncall: metrics green across 30m window. token_truncate.count back to baseline, p95/p99 nominal. :tada:
lena: posting customer advisory now.
support-bot: posted customer advisory id=CA-4439 to #support
carol: good work. scheduling short PM to capture why canary missed the tokenizer edge-case.
dave: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-21 15:00 UTC. invites sent.
erin: closing DR-8929. :white_check_mark:
